parts.name: NumberField
parts.description: A text spinbutton with exact decimal stepping and custom increment/decrement buttons. Native input attributes and ref target the text input; value changes use onValueChange.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label and accessible name.

props.name: hint
props.description: Supporting field guidance, associated with the control.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Replaces hint text and marks the field invalid.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled finite number or null for an empty field.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial finite number or null when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the edited/committed number or null when cleared.

props.name: min
props.description: Optional finite lower bound. Must not exceed max.

props.name: max
props.description: Optional finite upper bound. Must not be less than min.

props.name: step
props.description: Positive finite decimal increment; stepping is anchored to min or zero.

props.name: incrementLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the increment action.

props.name: decrementLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the decrement action.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native control.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Keeps the current value readable and focusable while preventing editing.

props.name: required
props.description: Requires a non-empty native control value during form validation.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form submission field name.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown when the control has no value.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Native key handler. Prevent default to skip built-in Arrow/Home/End/Enter handling.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the native control receives focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the native control loses focus.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: IDs of additional descriptive elements; field components merge these with their hint or error ID.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: Native control ID. Generated when omitted; the visible label and supporting text use this association.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
